name: site-editor
description: Monorepo for the Site Editor visual copy editor and its demo site.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/site-editor && npm run build -w site-editor-demo && npm run build -w site-editor-demo-astro
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @thereactnativerewind/site-editor && npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/site-editor && npm run typecheck -w site-editor-demo
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/site-editor && npm run migrate -w @thereactnativerewind/site-editor
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/site-editor && npm run dev -w site-editor-demo
